g.title: TF_WFPROCESS_STAGE_CONTEXTS
g.text: Workflow Process Stage Contexts - Workflow Process Stage Contexts
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: TF_WFPROCESSES
g.text: This message will be displayed to the end user when trying to launch this process for an entity which is not eligible.
